method: recursive repository-tree inspection, targeted code search, critical-path source review, clean-diff verification, unit tests and CI; this is a targeted security audit, not formal verification
threat_model: Foreign/model-generated information may be observed, but it must not automatically become persistent JANUS identity, policy, persona, trait-training signal, or cross-entity identity ancestry.
scientific_basis: Nature 2026 s41586-026-10319-8 — hidden behavioural trait transmission through model-generated data
arXiv:2602.04899 — Phantom Transfer / data-level defenses can be insufficient in some constructions
arXiv:2608.26958 — submitted 2026-08-27; scaling independent model-generated distillation data can make latent teacher traits more recoverable
